facts.fact: Ethio telecom, Djibouti Telecom and Sudatel Group signed a binding tripartite agreement at a ceremony in Djibouti to operationalise the Horizon Fiber corridor linking Djibouti's submarine cable gateways through Ethiopia to Sudan; no signing date is given, so the published date is used.

systems.owner: Djibouti Telecom, Ethio Telecom, Sudatel Group
